# Tags

The Core and AI tags ([SUPPORT_TIERS.md](https://github.com/danielgregorio/quantum/blob/main/SUPPORT_TIERS.md)): every attribute the parser accepts — a test fails when this list and the parser differ. Experimental tags are on [their own page](./experimental).

::: v-pre

<h1 class="reference-group">Core</h1>

<a id="q-component"></a>

## `q:component`

A page or a reusable component. A file of `components/` is served at its path ([ROUTE-1](./spec#ROUTE-1)).

| Attribute | Type | Required | Default | Values | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | yes |  |  | Component name |
| `require_auth` | boolean |  | `false` |  | Only an authenticated, unexpired session sees it ([AUTH-1](./spec#AUTH-1)) |
| `require_role` | string |  |  |  | Comma-separated roles, one of which `session.userRole` must have ([AUTH-2](./spec#AUTH-2)) |
| `login_url` | string |  |  |  | Where an unauthenticated visitor is sent; a local path ([AUTH-4](./spec#AUTH-4)) |
| `require_permission` | string |  |  |  | Required permission(s) |
| `interactive` | boolean |  | `false` |  | Client-side hydration |
| `type` | string |  | `pure` |  | Component type |
| `port` | integer |  |  |  | Port |

```xml
<q:component name="Home">
  <p>Hello</p>
</q:component>
```

Specified by: [AUTH-1](./spec#AUTH-1) · [AUTH-2](./spec#AUTH-2) · [AUTH-4](./spec#AUTH-4) · [PARSE-3](./spec#PARSE-3) · [ROUTE-1](./spec#ROUTE-1)

<a id="q-param"></a>

## `q:param`

A parameter of a component, function, action, query or tool, converted to `type` and checked against its rules ([FN-1](./spec#FN-1), [ACT-2](./spec#ACT-2), [DB-1](./spec#DB-1))

Inside: [`q:function`](#q-function), [`q:query`](#q-query), [`q:invoke`](#q-invoke), [`q:action`](#q-action), [`q:tool`](#q-tool)

| Attribute | Type | Required | Default | Values | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | yes |  |  | Parameter name |
| `type` | enum |  | `string` | `string`, `text`, `number`, `integer`, `int`, `long`, `numeric`, `decimal`, `float`, `double`, `boolean`, `email`, `url`, `date`, `array`, `object`, `json`, `any`, `file`, `binary`, `upload`, `datetime`, `time` | Type the value is converted to. `datetime` and `time` exist only for a q:query's param; in a q:query the type is one of string, integer, decimal, boolean, datetime, date, time, array, json ([PARSE-5](./spec#PARSE-5)) |
| `default` | string |  |  |  | Value when none is given |
| `value` | expression |  |  |  | The value bound (in a q:query, q:invoke) |
| `description` | string |  |  |  | What it is (shown to the model in a q:tool) |
| `validate` | string |  |  | `email`, `url`, `phone`, `cep`, `cpf`, `cnpj`, `uuid`, `creditcard`, `ipv4`, `ipv6` | A named validator, or a regular expression starting with `^` |
| `accept` | string |  |  |  | Accepted uploads: `image/*`, `.pdf`, `application/pdf` ([ACT-11](./spec#ACT-11)) |
| `maxsize` | string |  |  |  | Largest upload: `500KB`, `5MB`, `1GB` ([FILE-1](./spec#FILE-1)) |
| `maxLength` | integer |  |  |  | Longest text bound to a query ([DB-1](./spec#DB-1)) |
| `scale` | integer |  |  |  | Decimal places a query value is rounded to ([DB-1](./spec#DB-1)) |
| `null` | boolean |  |  |  | Bind an empty value as NULL (q:query) |
| `source` | string |  |  |  | Where the value comes from |
| `required` | boolean |  | `false` |  | The value must be given and not empty |
| `min` | decimal |  |  |  | Smallest number accepted |
| `max` | decimal |  |  |  | Largest number accepted |
| `minlength` | integer |  |  |  | Shortest text accepted |
| `maxlength` | integer |  |  |  | Longest text accepted |
| `pattern` | regex |  |  |  | Regular expression the text must match |
| `enum` | string |  |  |  | Comma-separated list of the values accepted |
| `range` | string |  |  |  | Inclusive range, e.g. `1..10` |

```xml
<q:param name="age" type="integer" required="true" min="18" />
```

Specified by: [ACT-2](./spec#ACT-2) · [ACT-6](./spec#ACT-6) · [ACT-11](./spec#ACT-11) · [DB-1](./spec#DB-1) · [ERR-1](./spec#ERR-1) · [FILE-1](./spec#FILE-1) · [FN-1](./spec#FN-1) · [IA-4](./spec#IA-4) · [INV-1](./spec#INV-1) · [PARSE-3](./spec#PARSE-3) · [PARSE-5](./spec#PARSE-5) · [SVC-3](./spec#SVC-3) · [TEST-3](./spec#TEST-3) · [UI-6](./spec#UI-6) · [UI-9](./spec#UI-9) · [UI-10](./spec#UI-10) · [UI-14](./spec#UI-14)

<a id="q-set"></a>

## `q:set`

Stores a variable, converted to `type`, checked and changed by `operation` ([ERR-1](./spec#ERR-1), [SET-1](./spec#SET-1), [SET-3](./spec#SET-3), [SET-4](./spec#SET-4))

Inside: [`q:action`](#q-action)

| Attribute | Type | Required | Default | Values | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | yes |  |  | Variable name (`session.x`, `application.x` for the scopes) |
| `value` | expression |  |  |  | The value |
| `type` | enum |  |  | `string`, `number`, `integer`, `decimal`, `boolean`, `array`, `object`, `json`, `text`, `int`, `long`, `numeric`, `float`, `double` | Type the value is converted to ([ERR-1](./spec#ERR-1)); without it, a value that is one expression keeps its type ([SET-5](./spec#SET-5)) |
| `default` | string |  |  |  | Stored when value resolves to nothing ([SET-1](./spec#SET-1)) |
| `operation` | enum |  | `assign` | `assign`, `increment`, `decrement`, `add`, `multiply`, `append`, `prepend`, `remove`, `removeAt`, `clear`, `sort`, `reverse`, `unique`, `merge`, `setProperty`, `deleteProperty`, `clone`, `uppercase`, `lowercase`, `trim`, `format` | What to do with the variable ([SET-3](./spec#SET-3)) |
| `step` | integer |  | `1` |  | Step of increment/decrement |
| `index` | integer |  |  |  | Position for removeAt |
| `key` | string |  |  |  | Key for setProperty/deleteProperty |
| `source` | string |  |  |  | Variable clone copies |
| `scope` | enum |  | `local` | `local`, `function`, `component`, `session`, `application`, `request` | Where the variable lives |
| `nullable` | boolean |  | `true` |  | `false`: a null value is an error |
| `validate` | string |  |  | `email`, `url`, `phone`, `cep`, `cpf`, `cnpj`, `uuid`, `creditcard`, `ipv4`, `ipv6` | A named validator, or a regular expression starting with `^` ([SET-4](./spec#SET-4)) |
| `required` | boolean |  | `false` |  | The value must be given and not empty |
| `min` | decimal |  |  |  | Smallest number accepted |
| `max` | decimal |  |  |  | Largest number accepted |
| `minlength` | integer |  |  |  | Shortest text accepted |
| `maxlength` | integer |  |  |  | Longest text accepted |
| `pattern` | regex |  |  |  | Regular expression the text must match |
| `enum` | string |  |  |  | Comma-separated list of the values accepted |
| `range` | string |  |  |  | Inclusive range, e.g. `1..10` |

```xml
<q:set name="total" value="{price * qty}" type="number" />
```

## `q:query`

Runs SQL on a declared datasource, binding `:name` to q:param ([DB-1](./spec#DB-1)..[DB-5](./spec#DB-5), [DB-9](./spec#DB-9), [UI-13](./spec#UI-13))

Inside: [`q:transaction`](#q-transaction), [`q:action`](#q-action)

| Attribute | Type | Required | Default | Values | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string |  |  |  | Result variable (`<name>`, `<name>_result`) |
| `datasource` | string |  |  |  | Datasource declared in quantum.config.yaml, or `knowledge:<name>` ([IA-3](./spec#IA-3)) |
| `source` | string |  |  |  | Query of queries: an earlier query's name ([DB-3](./spec#DB-3)) |
| `result` | string |  |  |  | Another name for `<name>_result` |
| `paginate` | boolean |  | `false` |  | Return one page ([DB-2](./spec#DB-2)) |
| `page` | expression |  |  |  | Page number, an expression ([DB-9](./spec#DB-9)) |
| `pageSize` | integer |  |  |  | Rows per page |
| `page_size` | integer |  |  |  | Rows per page |
| `sortable` | boolean |  | `false` |  | Sort by the URL's ?sort=/&dir= ([UI-13](./spec#UI-13)) |
| `onerror` | enum |  | `fail` | `fail`, `continue` | `fail` stops the page with the error; `continue` hands it to `<name>_result` ([INV-2](./spec#INV-2), [IA-5](./spec#IA-5)) |

Contains: `q:param`

<h1 class="reference-group">AI</h1>

<a id="q-llm"></a>

## `q:llm`

A model call; with knowledge=, an answer that cites its sources ([IA-1](./spec#IA-1), [IA-5](./spec#IA-5)..[IA-9](./spec#IA-9))

| Attribute | Type | Required | Default | Values | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | yes |  |  | Result variable |
| `model` | expression |  |  |  | Model, an expression; else QUANTUM_LLM_DEFAULT_MODEL / llm.model ([IA-1](./spec#IA-1)) |
| `endpoint` | expression |  |  |  | Another model server for this tag |
| `apiKey` | expression |  |  |  | API key |
| `provider` | enum |  |  | `ollama`, `openai`, `anthropic`, `claude`, `lmstudio`, `auto` | Provider |
| `temperature` | decimal |  |  |  | Temperature |
| `maxTokens` | integer |  |  |  | Most tokens to generate |
| `responseFormat` | enum |  | `text` | `text`, `json` | `json`: the value is the parsed object |
| `timeout` | integer |  | `60` |  | Seconds to wait for the model |
| `knowledge` | string |  |  |  | Answer from this q:knowledge, citing it ([IA-6](./spec#IA-6)) |
| `top` | integer |  | `4` |  | Chunks to retrieve |
| `minRelevance` | decimal |  | `0` |  | Chunks below it are not retrieved, 0 to 1 ([IA-9](./spec#IA-9)) |
| `stream` | boolean |  | `false` |  | In a web request, the answer arrives as it is written ([IA-7](./spec#IA-7)) |
| `cache` | boolean |  | `false` |  | Cache the answer |
| `ttl` | integer |  |  |  | Cache seconds |
| `onerror` | enum |  | `fail` | `fail`, `continue` | `fail` stops the page with the error; `continue` hands it to `<name>_result` ([INV-2](./spec#INV-2), [IA-5](./spec#IA-5)) |

Contains: `q:prompt`, `q:message`, `q:system`

```xml
<q:llm name="answer" model="phi3" knowledge="docs" minRelevance="0.79">
  <q:message role="user">{question}</q:message>
</q:llm>
```

Specified by: [IA-1](./spec#IA-1) · [IA-2](./spec#IA-2) · [IA-3](./spec#IA-3) · [IA-5](./spec#IA-5) · [IA-6](./spec#IA-6) · [IA-7](./spec#IA-7) · [IA-8](./spec#IA-8) · [IA-9](./spec#IA-9) · [INV-2](./spec#INV-2)
